name: Helios-Nomad SynthShell All-Weather Modular Coat
description: A full-length weathershell coat in gunmetal grey with modular limb extensions — sleeve and hem panels clip on via industrial-grade fasteners to accommodate varying limb lengths across different chassis models. Thermal lining inserts are removable for summer use, and the collar seals magnetically against lake-effect wind. Inner lining pockets are positioned for non-human reach geometry. Underneath: a thermally bonded base layer tunic and legging in matte slate, sold as a bundle.
functionality: Modular clip-extension limb panels, removable thermal lining, magnetic collar seal for sub-zero lake-effect conditions.
what_it_says: I am built to survive this city's weather, whatever this city thinks of what I am.
worn_by: free synthetics in Shelf and Circuit zones
story_hooks: The coat's inner lining has been used to smuggle synthetic ID documents across checkpoints for three seasons.
A synthetic wearing this was caught in the lake-effect blizzard of '98 and survived forty hours exposed — the coat became a symbol.
